entries.title: Themes admin list showing Corporate.
entries.notes: Capture after installing capell-app/theme-corporate with Foundation Theme and creating a Corporate theme record in the isolated demo harness.
entries.useCase: An administrator sees the Corporate theme record in the host Themes admin surface.

entries.title: Signed admin preview route.
entries.notes: Capture a temporary signed preview URL generated from the host Themes table for the Corporate theme.
entries.useCase: An administrator opens a preview URL to inspect a page with the Corporate theme applied.

entries.title: Frontend page rendered with Corporate theme.
entries.notes: Capture the seeded Corporate Demo Homepage route that renders navigation, hero, features, proof, content listing, CTA, and footer through the Corporate renderer.
entries.useCase: A visitor sees a seeded public page rendered through every Corporate theme section.

entries.title: Corporate homepage.
entries.notes: Capture the basic boardroom homepage with formal hero, decision proof, capability bands, and restrained CTA.
entries.useCase: A business team reviews Corporate as a polished basic preset for board papers and formal service sites.

entries.title: Services page.
entries.notes: Capture formal service cards, process notes, outcome proof, and contact CTA.
entries.useCase: A business buyer checks that services read as boardroom-ready rather than SaaS features or local job cards.

entries.title: Governance page.
entries.notes: Capture governance content with policy sections, document cards, decision trail, and leadership proof. Requires capell-app/document-lifecycle; show this package note on the captured image.
entries.useCase: A corporate team can publish formal decision material without the theme pretending to be a premium enterprise workflow.

entries.title: Resources listing.
entries.notes: Capture board-paper and resource cards with filters, topic navigation, and formal metadata. Requires capell-app/tags; show this package note on the captured image.
entries.useCase: A visitor can browse formal resources without the page becoming Knowledge's research archive.

entries.title: Thought leadership article.
entries.notes: Capture a formal article with body copy, author details, related board papers, and contact route. Requires capell-app/blog; show this package note on the captured image.
entries.useCase: A business site can publish leadership material while keeping a restrained corporate rhythm.

entries.title: Contact form page.
entries.notes: Capture office details, procurement/investor/service routing notes, form fields, and confirmation state. Requires capell-app/form-builder; show this package note on the captured image.
entries.useCase: A business team checks that enquiries route cleanly without becoming a broad lead-generation page.

entries.title: Locations page.
entries.notes: Capture office cards, address metadata, map-ready panels, and regional contact routing. Requires capell-app/address; show this package note on the captured image.
entries.useCase: A formal organisation can show locations and contact routes without local-services styling.

entries.title: Search results page.
entries.notes: Capture search results with board-paper grouping, snippets, and conservative recovery state. Requires capell-app/search; show this package note on the captured image.
entries.useCase: A visitor can find corporate material without the page looking like product search or an editorial archive.

entries.title: Event detail page.
entries.notes: Capture an investor or stakeholder event with agenda, registration, related documents, and formal proof. Requires capell-app/events; show this package note on the captured image.
entries.useCase: A corporate team can publish stakeholder events without overlapping SaaS webinars or nonprofit community events.
